title: TikTok permanently bans ad account for Elon Musk documentary
excerpt: TikTok has permanently banned an advertising account promoting a four-hour documentary about Elon Musk.
body_html:
Social media platform TikTok has permanently banned an advertising account used to promote a four-hour documentary about Elon Musk.

The documentary, which focuses on the prominent tech figure, has continued to encounter restrictions and resistance across various social media platforms as its promoters attempt to advertise the film online.
